subject: Reference appreciation: allocation plan for customer credit, gifts, and charity receipt
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cathy Ramos <cathy.ramos@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Reference appreciation: allocation plan for customer credit, gifts, and charity receipt

Hi Cathy —

Thanks again for agreeing to be a reference for Redwood. We really appreciate the time your team spent on the call last week. To say thanks, we have a few options and are happy to follow whatever works best for Acme:

1) Service credit (one-time): $500 account credit that can be applied to any Redwood invoices
2) Swag: a two-item appreciation pack (branded backpack + wireless charger) for the person(s) you nominate
3) Charity donation: we can donate $100 to a charity of your choice and provide a donation receipt for your records

Attached is a one-pager with the options and the simple recipient form (advocacy-options-20261110.pdf).

If you want a mix (credit split + charity, etc.) that’s fine — we can split the credit across teams and route swag/donation receipts as you prefer. Could you confirm your preferred option and the name/address for swag shipping (if applicable)? Also let us know if procurement needs a PO or any documentation.

Thanks again — everyone here really values Acme’s participation.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: advocacy-options-20261110.pdf

From: Cathy Ramos <cathy.ramos@acme-retail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reference appreciation: allocation plan for customer credit, gifts, and charity receipt

Thanks Jasmine — really appreciate the choices. Quick answers from our side: we’d like to do a split approach if possible.

- Donation: please donate $100 to Books for All (local nonprofit) and send the donation receipt to procurement@acme-retail.com
- Swag: please send one appreciation pack to our director of partnerships (name and shipping address below)
- Credit: can the remaining $400 be split $250 to RetailOps team and $150 to Marketing? If you need a PO or a form, procurement@acme-retail.com is on copy.

Shipping contact:
Elena Park
Director, Partnerships
Acme Retail
120 Harbor Blvd, Suite 100
San Mateo, CA 94401

Procurement, can you confirm if you need a vendor form or a PO for the donation/credit?

Appreciate it — Cathy

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Cathy Ramos <cathy.ramos@acme-retail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reference appreciation: allocation plan for customer credit, gifts, and charity receipt

Thanks Cathy — this is straightforward. Internal plan:

- Donation: we will route $100 to Books for All and get a PDF donation receipt. Ben, can you confirm payroll/billing code and whether we need a vendor form for the donation? I’ve attached the recipient form for the swag routing (ma_recipient_form.xlsx) — please complete the recipient fields and return.
- Swag: ship one appreciation pack to Elena Park at the address provided. Team Ops will include a packing slip referencing "Acme reference — Redwood".
- Credit split: we can issue a $400 credit split $250 to RetailOps and $150 to Marketing. Cathy, procurement should confirm whether you want the credit recorded against one account and distributed internally, or if you need two separate credit memos.

Next steps: Ben to prepare the donation receipt and billing notes; Jasmine to prepare the credit memos/DocuSign acceptance link; Marissa will confirm shipping label.

Marissa Cole
Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: ma_recipient_form.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reference appreciation: allocation plan for customer credit, gifts, and charity receipt

Hi all — quick confirmation from billing/ops side:

- Donation: the $100 to Books for All is processed. Please find the donation receipt attached (donation-receipt-BooksForAll-20261112.pdf). Procurement, let me know if you need any additional tax documentation.
- Credit: I generated two credit memos — RetailOps $250 (CM-20261112-RO) and Marketing $150 (CM-20261112-MKT). I’ve sent a DocuSign acceptance link for Cathy to acknowledge the credits: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-advocate-credit
- Swag: shipping label created; tracking will be shared here once the carrier scans the package (link to label: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1xExampleShipLabel).

Cathy — once you sign the DocuSign, I’ll finalize the credit memos. Otherwise happy to answer any procurement questions.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
